records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Logistics
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for setting up Cedar Logistics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 but no invite in 6 days; key milestone unreached with 8 days left. draft.subject: Following up on your notification badge ticket
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for the reply last week. Your ticket about the notification badge count is still open, and Tariq is on it — I'm keeping an eye on it from my side too so it doesn't go quiet.

Since our getting started call, I also wanted to flag one easy next step: you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and Wrenfield works best once a couple of people are sharing tasks inside a project.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through that first invite with you.

Best,
Priya
